title: Read Schema
description: As a user importing a schema, I want the backend to introspect the PostgreSQL schema so that the frontend can render it as a diagram.
acceptanceCriteria: Given an active connection, when the frontend calls the read-schema endpoint, then the backend returns tables, columns, data types, primary keys, foreign keys, unique constraints, and indexes in a structured format

evidence: Implementation verified by code review: all STORY-017 acceptance criteria satisfied by existing code — backend/src/routes/read-schema.ts (POST /api/read-schema mounted in backend/src/app.ts), backend/src/services/introspection.service.ts (5 parameterized read-only introspection queries, BEGIN READ ONLY transaction, statement timeout), backend/src/types/read-schema.ts (Zod ReadSchemaRequestSchema + ReadSchemaResponse), database/introspection.sql (5 read-only PostgreSQL 14+ queries), src/connection/readSchemaApi.ts (frontend readSchema() client), docs/api/read-schema.md (API spec)

Acceptance criteria mapping: endpoint accepts active connection parameters (host, port, database, user, password, schema) validated via Zod; backend returns tables, columns, data types, primary keys, foreign keys, unique constraints, and indexes in structured ReadSchemaResponse format; error handling 400/401/502/504/500; database password redacted in error messages; queries parameterized ($1) with no SQL interpolation

Tests present: backend/src/routes/read-schema.test.ts (12 route tests), backend/src/services/introspection.service.test.ts (12 service unit tests), backend/src/__tests__/read-schema.integration.test.ts (6 integration tests seeded against real PostgreSQL via database/seed.sql)
